scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const copy=(srcRel,destRel)=>{const src=path.join(process.cwd(),srcRel); const dest=path.join(process.cwd(),destRel); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);}; copy('src/models/initial_form.json','dist/models/initial_form.json'); copy('src/models/schemas/groq_assistant_instructions.txt','dist/models/schemas/groq_assistant_instructions.txt');"
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm run start
